verdict.rationale: AutoGen is itself an official Microsoft Python SDK. It ships as pip-installable packages (`autogen-agentchat`, `autogen-ext[openai]`) with a documented programmatic API: `AssistantAgent`, `agent.run`, custom agents, and several team types (RoundRobin, Selector, Swarm, GraphFlow). Studio teams can also be exported to Python code. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Python (no other language bindings shown), API-stability assurances (a 0.2→0.4 migration guide implies breaking changes, and the older `pyautogen` package name adds confusion), and independent hands-on corroboration of the current SDK.
